verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. لِعَبْدِ ٱلرَّبِّ دَاوُدَ نَأْمَةُ مَعْصِيَةِ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ فِي دَاخِلِ قَلْبِي أَنْ لَيْسَ خَوْفُ ٱللهِ أَمَامَ عَيْنَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David the servant of the LORD. The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, [that there is] no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of Yahweh. A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ مَلَّقَ نَفْسَهُ لِنَفْسِهِ مِنْ جِهَةِ وِجْدَانِ إِثْمِهِ وَبُغْضِهِلإ.
verses.kjv: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
verses.web: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

verses.ar: كَلَامُ فَمِهِ إِثْمٌ وَغِشٌّ. كَفَّ عَنِ ٱلتَّعَقُّلِ، عَنْ عَمَلِ ٱلْخَيْرِ.
verses.kjv: The words of his mouth [are] iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, [and] to do good.
verses.web: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

verses.ar: يَتَفَكَّرُ بِٱلْإِثْمِ عَلَى مَضْجَعِهِ. يَقِفُ فِي طَرِيقٍ غَيْرِ صَالِحٍ. لَا يَرْفُضُ ٱلشَّرَّ.
verses.kjv: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way [that is] not good; he abhorreth not evil.
verses.web: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ، فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ رَحْمَتُكَ. أَمَانَتُكَ إِلَى ٱلْغَمَامِ.
verses.kjv: Thy mercy, O LORD, [is] in the heavens; [and] thy faithfulness [reacheth] unto the clouds.
verses.web: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

verses.ar: عَدْلُكَ مِثْلُ جِبَالِ ٱللهِ، وَأَحْكَامُكَ لُجَّةٌ عَظِيمَةٌ. ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱلْبَهَائِمَ تُخَلِّصُ يَارَبُّ.
verses.kjv: Thy righteousness [is] like the great mountains; thy judgments [are] a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.
verses.web: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and animal.

verses.ar: مَا أَكْرَمَ رَحْمَتَكَ يَا ٱللهُ! فَبَنُو ٱلْبَشَرِ فِي ظِلِّ جَنَاحَيْكَ يَحْتَمُونَ.
verses.kjv: How excellent [is] thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
verses.web: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

verses.ar: يَرْوَوْنَ مِنْ دَسَمِ بَيْتِكَ، وَمِنْ نَهْرِ نِعَمِكَ تَسْقِيهِمْ.
verses.kjv: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
verses.web: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ عِنْدَكَ يَنْبُوعَ ٱلْحَيَاةِ. بِنُورِكَ نَرَى نُورًا.
verses.kjv: For with thee [is] the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
verses.web: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

verses.ar: أَدِمْ رَحْمَتَكَ لِلَّذِينَ يَعْرِفُونَكَ، وَعَدْلَكَ لِلْمُسْتَقِيمِي ٱلْقَلْبِ.
verses.kjv: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.web: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.ar: لَا تَأْتِنِي رِجْلُ ٱلْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَيَدُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ لَا تُزَحْزِحْنِي.
verses.kjv: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
verses.web: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

verses.ar: هُنَاكَ سَقَطَ فَاعِلُو ٱلْإِثْمِ. دُحِرُوا فَلَمْ يَسْتَطِيعُوا ٱلْقِيَامَ.
verses.kjv: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
verses.web: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
